  (∀ (i j : Col), QuarticQuery.Upper.Samples c fun x b => QuarticQuery.Upper.bern (a x i j) b) →
    ∀ (p : ℕ → Col) (t : ℕ),
      ∃ L,
        QuarticQuery.Upper.Samples (t * c) L ∧
          ∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput ι) (i : Col),
            L x (Option.some i) = (∏ b ∈ Finset.range t, a x i (p b)) / ↑(Fintype.card Col)

presentation.body: Given pivots $p_1,\ldots,p_t$ with $t<T$: prepare uniform $\lvert i\rangle$ over $[m]$, compare $i$ with each pivot in a fresh workspace, set the success bit if and only if every comparison says $i$ defeats its pivot, keeping all garbage. Apply Lemma 3.1 with $\gamma=1/(2m)$, $\eta=\varepsilon$. On failure stop and return the accumulated list; otherwise measure the index, append, and continue for at most $T$ stages.
presentation.body_plain: Given pivots p₁, …, pₜ with t < T: prepare uniform |i⟩ over [m], compare i with each pivot in a fresh workspace, set the success bit if and only if every comparison says i defeats its pivot, keeping all garbage. Apply Lemma 3.1 with γ = 1/(2m), η = ε. On failure stop and return the accumulated list; otherwise measure the index, append, and continue for at most T stages.
